name: Equity bear market (factor shock)
description: Instantaneous market fall of 20% with small caps underperforming large caps by 10%, mapped to every asset through its Carhart factor betas.
rationale: Illustrative, not a forecast. A -20% market shock lies between the 2018 (-14.6%) and COVID (-38.4%) Nifty 50 drawdowns in our cache. SMB -10% encodes the assumption that small caps fall more than large caps in a sell-off.
caveats: Debt, liquid and gold funds have R^2 near 0 against equity factors, so their factor-implied shocks are close to 0 and unreliable; the result flags them.
